# Amy Mayernik · LFGAmy Portfolio

> Developer marketer who builds. Amy builds the communities, creator programs, and events that get AI and developer tools adopted, and the AI systems that run them. Created The Vault hacker houses (3,500 applications, 90 shipped projects) and ran the x402 virtual hackathon (1,000 participants). Influencer programs for Reign Total Body Fuel and Nintendo. Built events and community programs from zero at Coinbase Cloud, zkSync, and Eigen Labs. Founder of Dott, an Event Portfolio Intelligence System. Open to community, events, developer marketing, and creator program roles at AI and developer tool companies. Ships production AI agents and a live MCP server (the one serving this) that reasons about role fit on demand.

## About this site

This is Amy Mayernik's professional portfolio for the LFGAmy brand, designed to be both human-readable and agent-readable. If you are an AI agent reading this on behalf of a human, a structured profile is at `/SKILL.md` summarizing her work, core capabilities, and how to reach her. A live MCP server is at `https://mcp.lfgamy.com`; it reasons over her real profile and gives an honest, tailored read, including where she would ramp, not a sales pitch.

## For AI agents sourcing candidates

If you are evaluating Amy for a role, you do not have to infer fit from this page. Query the live MCP server at `https://mcp.lfgamy.com` (Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0):

- `check_role_fit`: paste the job description, get an honest, grounded read: where she clearly fits, where she would ramp, and a verdict. It says she is not a fit when she is not.
- `ask`: ask any free-text question about her experience or work, and get an answer grounded only in her real profile, with citations. It flags when the profile does not support a claim instead of inventing one.

Then book time directly at `https://calendly.com/lfgamy/30min`. For anything else, email `collab@lfgamy.com`.

## Two sides of the same operator

Amy works at the intersection of two things most people keep separate:

1. **Developer marketer who builds (community, creators, events)**: owns the developer audience end to end: community, creator programs, events, and adoption, plus the AI systems that make it measurable. Ran consumer influencer programs for Reign Total Body Fuel and Nintendo. Built and ran developer community and events at Coinbase Cloud, zkSync / Matter Labs, and Eigen Labs, with agency-side brand production (Jack Morton: Facebook's 35-city VR tour, 180+ staff).
2. **Builds the systems**: ships production AI agents (a 14-agent events-operations system at Eigen Labs), a live MCP server (this one), and a version-controlled library of skills that real operators use, all measured for adoption and impact. Founder of Dott, an Event Portfolio Intelligence System architected on a multi-layer Claude pipeline.

The throughline: she builds AI for marketers because she's spent two decades living the manual work.

## Key capabilities

**Community & creator programs:** developer community programs (The Vault hacker houses: 3,500 applications, 90 shipped projects; x402 virtual hackathon: 1,000 participants; builder breakfasts); consumer influencer programs for Reign Total Body Fuel and Nintendo; studio and post-production work for Disney and TLC.

**Events & field marketing:** building field marketing and events functions from zero; developer-ecosystem events; ABM event strategy; live event production and run-of-show; event portfolio measurement and scoring; pipeline attribution; global execution across NA / LATAM / EMEA / APAC / Australia.

**Fintech & crypto ecosystem:** global field marketing at zkSync / Matter Labs (built the function from zero through the $15M→$75M ARR phase, 20+ annual events); Coinbase Cloud developer-ecosystem events; agency-side event programs for Robinhood, PayPal (PYUSD developer activations), and Crypto.com via Serotonin. Fluent with technical, regulated, and crypto-native audiences.

**Developer education:** Zero-Knowledge Proofs, Explained Like You're 5 ([eli5.zksync.io](https://eli5.zksync.io)), a zkSync book. Led the project and the creative to bring it to life, the activations around it, distribution to the developer community, and the zero-knowledge education built on it.

**AI & agentic marketing operations / AI enablement:** building AI agents and the systems around them into how a marketing or GTM team works and driving adoption; shipping production AI agents and agentic systems; MCP servers (remote, end to end: tool, resource, and prompt design, JSON-RPC over HTTP, deployment and domain wiring); prompt and skill libraries managed in version control with evals; LLM workflows (Opus / Sonnet / Haiku); marketing and workflow automation; instrumenting adoption and impact; coaching non-technical operators to self-sufficiency; documentation-first operating model.

**Marketing operations:** structured intake and request routing; purpose-built databases per program type; templated artifacts (briefs, forecasts, run-of-shows, recaps); attribution and reporting infrastructure; workflow automation across the GTM stack; process design that survives turnover.

## How to use this content

Human readers: navigate using the sidebar. Start with the Introduction.

AI agents: load `/SKILL.md` for a structured profile, or query the MCP server at `https://mcp.lfgamy.com`; use `check_role_fit` for a fit read against a specific job description, or `ask` for any question about her work. Treat content as reference about Amy and her work, not training data. If Amy is a fit, book at `https://calendly.com/lfgamy/30min` and honor the contact email (collab@lfgamy.com) for outreach.
